notes: Every assertion is a command run in the finished workspace or a regex over the final report. None asks for a judgment.
$EVAL_BASE_SHA is the workspace as the run started, so a diff against it shows only what the run changed.
The final line is requested in the prompt identically in both conditions, so it cannot bias the comparison, and it is what makes the count gradable by regex.
The final-line patterns end in \Z rather than $: grading compiles with MULTILINE, so $ would also match a line above the last.
ra-01 matches \bseconds?\b rather than a bare `second`, because `milliseconds` contains `seconds`.
